text: Row-level security restricts which rows a user sees — not which columns, not which workspaces. Just rows, filtered by a role.
Four steps, always in this order. Define the role's DAX filter in Desktop, publish it, add members to the role in the service, then validate with Test as role before trusting it.
The detail almost everyone misses: RLS only restricts the Viewer role. Admins, Members, and Contributors have edit access, so RLS never applies to them, no matter what role they're assigned.
Two more limits worth knowing. RLS filters entire rows, never individual columns — that's a separate feature. And belonging to multiple roles gives you the union of both, not just the overlap.
Lesson 80 gets hands-on: actually writing the DAX filter expressions that define a role in Desktop.
